title: Business & economy
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Third of the four new B2 strands, anchored to work and money. The neighbour to avoid is b2_work, already live, which owns the EMPLOYMENT side — recruitment, applicant, internship, probation, appraisal, bonus, payroll, redundancy, dismissal, retirement — plus merger, bankruptcy and headquarters. The sweep returned all three of those as taught and they were dropped, along with invoice, bankrupt, profit, compete and invest. So this unit is the FIRM rather than the JOB: who owns it and who funds it (start-up, entrepreneur, investor, venture capital, shareholder, stake, dividend, subsidiary, board of directors, asset, liability), how the money moves through it (revenue, turnover, profit margin, cash flow, break even, balance sheet, audit, supplier, supply chain, wholesale, retail, logistics), and how it competes (acquisition, competitor, market share, target market, branding, customer base, outsource, tender, franchise, monopoly, niche). No C57 card — new strand, no predecessor — so card 0 names the work and money words it builds on. Build-the-family is half recap: compete and invest are already the student's and this unit adds competitor and investor; supply -> supplier and acquire -> acquisition run through the unit, with the two base verbs named on the card itself, the same convention as b2_pie_roots. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: What you already have
cards.note: This is a new strand. Work 1 to 4 gave you the job — recruitment, interview, salary, bonus, promotion, redundancy, retirement — and Money 1 and 2 gave you paying for things. This unit is not about either. It is about the firm itself: who owns it, who pays for it, how the money moves through it, and how it stays ahead of the shop opposite.
cards.note_cz: Tohle je nová větev. Work 1 až 4 ti daly zaměstnání — recruitment, interview, salary, bonus, promotion, redundancy, retirement — a Money 1 a 2 platení. Tahle lekce není ani o jednom. Je o firmě samotné: kdo ji vlastní, kdo ji platí, jak jí protékají peníze a jak zůstane před obchodem naproti.
